label: skimmer outpost
note: IP-neutral. Issue #838: a Remnant skimmer outpost over the ringed giant, the station city's version of a ranch outpost. The station kit at its smallest (src/systems/world/station_hull.gd draws every box from these numbers, as for orbital_station.json): one tower of one round floor 80 m across (the second tower's markets_2 radius), the Remnant deck's rooms and people on it (StationFill use 'remnant', StationRemnant), and a small covered bay 56 m across (the moon's landing pit) at the end of a short tunnel, with two pads. Its roof is walkable like every top floor's (the rail round its edge, the shield over the gap to jetpack up through, the mast and beacon). Three landmarks in content/core/planets/ringed_giant.json use this one file, each its own outpost (its own name, its own Territory place station_<landmark id>).
pin_note: On the F11 map it is pinned as a Remnant outpost (content/core/flow/map.json kinds), saying who holds its deck, not as a station with a side view (GlobeMap.pins).

floors.roof_ladder_note: Issue #838: a ladder up to the first of the floor's ceiling hatches (the station kit's floor_hatch block: four shields over the walkway, jetpack up through one onto the roof), from the walkway to a handhold over the roof (StationHull._roof_ladder). Climbable: walk into it holding W, [E] at its top to climb down (content/core/flow/ladders.json).
floors.gantry_hatch_note: Issue #838: a 3 m hatch in the skimmer control room's floor (the room at 292.5 degrees), closed by a shield you drop through and jetpack back up through, the ladder beside it down to the skimmer gantry (StationHull._gantry_hatch), climbable as the roof's.

skimmer.crate_note: Issue #885: a supply crate on the gantry beside the tanks ([along, across], clear of the ladder, the trusses and the tanks), placed by the gear (pickups ringed_giant_town.json site_crates with a 'station'), opened once.
skimmer.note: Issue #838: the skimmer refinery, hung under the skimmer control room: a gantry deck 21 m under the floor's plate (the globe tank's top 2.4 m short of the plate; its blast, 22 m round, reaches the room above), on two pairs of trusses, railed, the intake pipe 70 m down toward the cloud tops (320 m under the deck) from its middle. 'units': the two quantonium tanks on it (QuantoniumRefinery, territory.json outposts.refinery's numbers), [along, across] on the gantry.

towers.antennas_note: Issue #838: past the tower's own mast and beacon, two dishes and three whip antennas on the roof, on the side away from the hatch (StationHull._antennas). Their posts and bases are solid: cover up there.

remnant_note: The whole floor is the Remnant's deck (StationRemnant, the same rooms, posts and repaint as the station city's): who holds it is Territory's place station_<landmark id>.

remnant.roof_note: Issue #838: one guard walking a loop round the roof (StationRemnant.posts), with a seeker launcher: the Remnant's roof_launcher, the locals' local_launcher once they hold the deck. The roof is always watched, whatever guard_share leaves off the posts below.

bay.note: The moon's landing pit's size: 56 m across, 16 m high, its mouth facing away from the deck. The tunnel to the deck's floor runs 22 m (90 - 28 - 40).

pads.note: Issue #885: the Remnant interceptor parked here, nose out of the mouth, in the holder's paint (SpaceStation._park_ships); flyable, and taking it raises the deck's alarm (ShipPilot.add_outpost_berth). Like a desert outpost's ship it is not saved: lost, it is back the next time you come to the giant.

dock.note: As the station city's (ShipPilot's docking autopilot), scaled to a bay half its size: in from approach metres off the mouth at hold_y over the deck, over or under the deck first when you start behind the mouth.
